questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q2: Replace formula substitution with placement and overlap reasoning.
questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q4: Remove repetitive identity equations and focus on the overlap property. Name bitwise OR explicitly in feedback to avoid linking to the Boolean logical-OR sense.
questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q5: Remove repeated row-index arithmetic; retain the largest-fitting coverage choice.
questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q9: Remove a duplicate sparse-table calculation and foreground the double-counted element.

adv-sparse-lca-applications.rationale: Euler-tour depth minima locate the LCA between first visits. The visible earlier glossary definition already includes every child return; prose avoids a bare tour link to the travelling-salesperson sense.

questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q11: Replace Euler-tour length arithmetic with the essential return-recording and minimum-depth mechanism. Clarify tree/array vocabulary to prevent wrong-sense automatic glossary links.

adv-persistent-path-copying.rationale: Copying only the modified search path preserves old roots and shares untouched branches. Pointer identity and old/new contents were executed; the document-version analogy stops before implying free memory reclamation.

questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q3: Replace approximate logarithmic node counts with the path-copying invariant. Clarify tree/array vocabulary to prevent wrong-sense automatic glossary links.
questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q10: Remove model-based memory substitutions while retaining sharing, balance and concurrency requirements.

adv-persistent-history-uses.rationale: Persistent versions support historical queries and product examples have different storage/concurrency contracts. Official Clojure, Git, filesystem and original LMDB sources support examples; unchanged data wording avoids fixed-capacity array terminology.

adv-rope-weighted-indexing.rationale: Left-subtree lengths route indexing without copying an entire string. Every character and invalid boundary was checked; the feedback now names the chosen child once and no formula card is needed.

questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q8: Replace coordinate arithmetic card with the meaning of each skipped subtree. Avoid database-index fallback links for local/global positions. Correct the duplicated chosen-child wording in the rope traversal feedback.

adv-rope-operations-tradeoffs.rationale: Concatenation, split and indexing depend on height, chunk sizes and balancing. Ten thousand chained appends demonstrate degeneration; feedback removes an unjustified precise weight/step count and Python-overflow distraction.

questionsRewritten.adv-sparse-tables-q12: Replace unsupported exact maximum weights and balanced traversal counts with the actual unbalanced-height diagnosis; Python integer lengths do not overflow at this example size.
